title.value: Quantum-Inspired Interpretable AI-Empowered Decision Support System for Detection of Early-Stage Rheumatoid Arthritis in Primary Care Using Scarce Dataset
title.justification: The title specifies the focus on an AI-based decision support system for detecting rheumatoid arthritis in primary care, using a quantum-inspired approach.
title.quote: Quantum-Inspired Interpretable AI-Empowered Decision Support System for Detection of Early-Stage Rheumatoid Arthritis in Primary Care Using Scarce Dataset.

extractions.description: The paper presents a quantum-inspired, interpretable AI decision support system designed to assist in the early detection of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) in primary care, utilizing Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) and a quantum learning algorithm to classify disease severity in a scarce dataset context. The system outperforms existing machine learning methods in accuracy, emphasizing the importance of early diagnosis for better patient outcomes.

primary_category.quote: We aim to develop a web-based Decision Support System (DSS) to provide a proper assistance for primary care providers in early detection of RA patients.
